notes:
E-Sys MAX 5.1.6

- Send us a message: you can now add a screenshot (Add picture, or Ctrl+V after Win+Shift+S).
- CAFD editor: the "Values from ECU" box under the tree keeps room to type on small laptop screens, and the line above it can be dragged to make it taller.
- E-Sys 23.x: activating an FA no longer stops with an error, and the drop-downs keep working.
- E-Sys 23.10 installed over 23.04: Settings no longer stop with an error.
- E-Sys 22.10: times in the VO preview, FA, cheat sheets and file names use your own time zone.
- E-Sys 3.30 to 3.36: Type and codes can change options, HO and E words; the picked FA row is readable in dark mode.
- Safer updates.
- Small fixes.
